title: User Story
description: Schema for an INVEST-compliant user story produced by Agente01_ProductOwner

title.description: Concise title that identifies the story

as_a.description: The user type performing the action — must be specific, not generic 'user'

i_want.description: The action or capability the user wants — observable behavior, not technical implementation

so_that.description: The benefit or value the user receives — the 'why' behind the want

story_points.description: Estimated effort in story points. Max 8 — larger stories must be split.

acceptance_criteria.description: BDD/Gherkin acceptance criteria — must include at minimum one happy path

invest_compliant.description: True only when all 6 INVEST dimensions have been explicitly verified

dependencies.description: IDs of stories this story depends on — ideally empty (INVEST: Independent)

related_business_rules.description: Business rules that apply to this story

notes.description: Additional context, constraints, or design notes
